## Services

- AI Agent & Automation Build: Turn a manual, repetitive workflow into an AI pipeline with a human in the loop.
- AI Feature for Your Product: Add a reliable AI feature to an app you already run, without breaking what works.
- Web or Mobile MVP: Go from idea to a real product people can sign up for, pay for and use.

## Featured case studies

- [UmrahFlow](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/umrahflow): Visa staff typed passport details by hand from photos pilgrims sent on WhatsApp. A WhatsApp agent reads each passport (MRZ checked against Claude vision), staff approve it on a dashboard, and approved passports are staged for the Saudi Nusuk portal.
- [Multi-Department POS](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/multi-department-pos): A cloth house records sales in each department but takes payment at one counter. Department tills issue tickets, one checkout settles them as a single bill, and the owner sees stock, shifts and returns.
- [BPOAI](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/bpoai): A BPO directory had to stay current without a team updating it by hand. Nine Claude-powered agents scrape new companies, score them, verify claims and run the email outreach.
- [homeStructure](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/home-structure): Homeowners want to see a house on their actual plot before they pay an architect. Enter the plot and the rooms you want, get a floor plan in seconds, walk around it in 3D and see a cost estimate. Everything runs in the browser.
- [FreeNote](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/projects/freenote-app): An hour-long lecture or meeting is hard to use if it only exists as audio. A React Native app that transcribes with Whisper, then summarises and answers questions about each recording with Groq.

## Blog posts

- [When NOT to Let the AI Finish the Job](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/when-not-to-let-ai-finish-the-job): Two production systems, one lesson: the most valuable line of code in an automation platform is the one that stops and asks a human. Why UmrahFlow halts before the government portal and why my POS makes owners approve discounts.
- [Multi-Tenant from Day One: Building for One Store, Architecting for SaaS](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/multi-tenant-from-day-one-pos-saas): My POS has exactly one customer, but every table has a tenantId. What multi-tenancy actually cost to add up front, what it buys later, and where the line is between preparing for SaaS and over-engineering.
- [Designing UI for People Who Do the Same 5 Actions 300 Times a Day](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/designing-ui-for-repetitive-retail-work): Retail staff are not "users exploring an interface" — they are operators under time pressure. How I designed a POS around tabular numerals, state-only color, keyboard-first tills, and chrome that disappears into the sale.
- [Modeling a Real Cloth House: Why My POS Has Tickets AND Bills](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/modeling-real-store-tickets-and-bills-pos): In a multi-department Pakistani cloth store, where a sale is recorded and where money is taken are different places. How that one domain insight shaped a Prisma schema of tickets, bills, shifts, and escalations.
- [Taming WhatsApp as an App Input: Debouncing Albums, Draining Queues](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/taming-whatsapp-as-an-app-input): WhatsApp is a terrible API and a perfect UX. How UmrahFlow turns messy real-world messages — photo albums, doubles, voice notes — into clean records with a Twilio-compatible relay, debounced draining, and agent traces.
- [Building Microservices to Someone Else's Contract](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-microservices-to-someone-elses-contract): The dashboard already existed; its ML services didn't. How I rebuilt two missing services to the exact API shape an existing app expected — without changing a line of dashboard code — and made five services start with one command.
- [Reading Passports with AI: Merging MRZ Parsing with Claude Vision](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/passport-ocr-mrz-claude-vision): MRZ parsing is deterministic but brittle; vision models read anything but can hallucinate. Why UmrahFlow's passport OCR cross-checks a local MRZ pass against a Claude vision pass — and falls back to OpenAI when it must.
- [From WhatsApp Photo to Government Portal: Automating Visa Processing](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/whatsapp-to-government-portal-visa-automation): How UmrahFlow takes a pilgrim from a WhatsApp message to a staged Umrah visa submission — an AI agent, passport OCR, a human-review dashboard, and a bridge into the Saudi Nusuk portal that deliberately stops one step short.
- [How the BPOAI Agent Flow Works](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-a-9-agent-ai-backend-for-bpoai): How I built the agent server behind BPOAI — nine specialized Claude-powered agents that scrape leads, score AI readiness, verify claims, run email outreach drips, and publish weekly news, all wired together through webhooks and cron.
- [Designing a Real House in the Browser: 2D Plans to Live 3D](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/designing-houses-in-the-browser-react-three-konva): How I built homeStructure — a climate-smart house design studio for a real irregular plot in Attock, with an editable 2D floor planner (react-konva), live 3D (react-three-fiber), and a passive-design score.
- [Building a BPO Directory & AI Hub with Supabase and Three.js](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-a-bpo-directory-ai-hub-supabase-three): A look at BPOAI — a directory and intelligence hub for the top BPO companies in the Philippines, combining a Supabase data layer with an immersive 3D landing experience.
- [An AI-Assisted Recruitment Platform with Next.js and MongoDB](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-assisted-recruitment-platform-nextjs-mongodb): How VoltOutreach streamlines hiring — job listings, candidate applications, an admin dashboard, and AI-assisted outreach with the Anthropic SDK, Cloudinary, and Calendly.
- [Barcode Scanning Meets Water Quality: PureX on Expo + Gemini](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/barcode-scanning-water-quality-mobile-gemini): Building PureX — a React Native app that scans product barcodes for nutrition and safety insights and surfaces location-based water-quality reports, powered by Google Gemini and Supabase.
- [Production-Ready Auth with NextAuth v5 and MongoDB](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/production-ready-auth-nextauth-v5-mongodb): A practical guide to the full account lifecycle — sign-up, login, protected routes, and email-based password reset — built with Next.js 16, NextAuth v5, MongoDB, and Nodemailer.
- [Building an AI Lead-Capture Platform for Trades Businesses](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-lead-capture-trades-businesses): How I built Plumber's Mate AI — an automation platform that captures leads, books jobs, sends quotes, collects payments, and re-engages old customers with Next.js 16 and React 19.
- [Canvas-Based AI Image Studios with Fabric.js and Next.js](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/canvas-ai-image-studio-fabricjs): A technical walkthrough of building Clay Imaginary — a drag-and-drop AI image studio with Fabric.js compositing, html2canvas export, and AI-powered generation for creators.
- [Next.js 20: Everything New You Need to Know](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/nextjs-20-whats-new): From React Server Functions to the revamped Turbopack pipeline and native Edge-first routing—here's what makes Next.js 20 the biggest release yet.
- [OpenClaw Deep Dive: Building Your Own AI Agent Pipeline](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/openclaw-deep-dive-setup): A hands-on technical walkthrough of setting up OpenClaw from scratch—configuring channels, creating custom skills, wiring up tool chains, and deploying your personal AI agent stack.
- [React Native with Expo in 2026: The Ultimate Mobile Stack](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/react-native-expo-2026): How Expo 54 and React Native 0.81 are making cross-platform mobile development faster than ever—from EAS builds to native modules, and why it's the go-to stack for startups.
- [OpenClaw: Your Personal AI Gateway to Messaging Apps](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/openclaw-personal-ai-gateway): How OpenClaw bridges WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and iMessage with AI agents—giving you a self-hosted, privacy-first AI assistant that actually does things.
- [AI Automation: Transforming the Future of Work](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-automation-future): Explore how AI-driven automation is reshaping industries—from intelligent workflows and autonomous coding agents to no-code platforms and the evolving role of developers.
- [Web Performance Optimization: A Complete Guide](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/web-performance-optimization): Master critical techniques like code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies, and Core Web Vitals to build blazing-fast web applications.
- [Building an AI-Powered Car Maintenance App](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-powered-car-maintenance): How I integrated Google Gemini AI with React Native to create intelligent dashboard light scanning, tire inspection, and maintenance quote analysis.
- [Building a Secure Marketplace with Escrow Payments](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/building-marketplace-with-escrow): A deep dive into implementing Stripe escrow payments, trade systems, and secure transactions for the Bible Trader marketplace platform.
- [Next 19 New Features](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/next-19-new-features): Explore the groundbreaking features introduced in Next.js 19, from enhanced performance to new routing capabilities.
- [Security Flaw: react2shell](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/security-flaw-react2shell): A critical look at the recently discovered security vulnerability in the react2shell library and how to mitigate it.
- [The Rise of AI Agents](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/ai-agents-revolution): How autonomous AI agents are transforming software development, automation, and the future of work.
- [Mastering Code & Speed Optimization](https://portfolio-wod3.vercel.app/blog/code-speed-optimization): Essential techniques to slash latency, optimize algorithms, and boost your application's response speed.
